decision: Is an additive whole saved-look collection backup/previewed restore with raw-string fidelity and guarded undo worth implementing now?
usableImprovement: Carry all named looks together to another browser/address, preserving names, IDs, order, configured colours and obsolete entries; explicit previewed replacement plus guarded Undo. This is proposed, not a completed feature.
boundedResearchQuestion: Can the existing version1 raw collection be portable through an explicit backup-envelope string without changing unsupported numeric literals, negative zero or lone UTF-16 surrogates? One literal current MDN JSON.stringify primary page in a separate admitted plan plus bounded storage-adapter fidelity/refusal tests; no search ladder.
witnesses: Complete current SavedLooks source: raw localStorage envelope version1/12 max, original metadata/parser authority; obsolete configurations retained; rename explicitly refuses nonfinite/-0 serialization changes.

Current Showcase HTML Saved looks paragraph says clearing browser data removes entries and only individual Download JSON is offered; individual unavailable configuration has Download disabled in actual source. No measured loss/current corruption claim.
Current export serializes one configuration; current Open settings accepts one supported configuration, not a collection. New workflow is an additive feature, not a bug allegation.
proposedContract: A separate same-origin no-avatar/no-GPU collection page; current preview remains open in its existing tab. Product entry link only after qualification. No core/asset/accepted look/wardrobe/motion changes.

Backup format exact keys format="sugata-saved-looks",version=1,raw=original localStorage string or null. JSON.stringify encodes raw as a STRING to preserve original numeric lexemes and escaped/lone surrogate code units; no parse/stringify of configurations. MIME application/json and bounded file input; null retains empty-source meaning.

Existing metadata parser remains authority; validation uses an isolated storage adapter feeding SavedLooks.read, no application write. Unsupported configurations stay unavailable for Open as now. Unknown backup versions/keys, bad metadata, duplicate IDs/names, oversize and unreadable file refuse without modifying storage.

File choice reads/validates only and shows names/count plus explicit replacement notice. Restore is a separate explicit human button after preview, compares full current raw snapshot again before one set/remove write. No automatic restore on select/load.

After successful replacement, one Undo restores the exact previous raw string or absent-key state only while current raw still equals applied raw. Intervening local/other-tab changes invalidate preview/undo; compare-and-write is existing best-effort synchronous storage guarding, not cross-tab atomic locking.

No-op leaves existing data and Undo unchanged; errors preserve prior raw and active preview. In-memory preview/undo are page-lifetime only, plainly stated. Download object URL lifecycle owned/revoked; pagehide cancels UI continuations and disposes listeners/URLs without claiming uncancellable File.text cancellation.

Candidate new modules/page remain unlinked and isolated from active Showcase until full independent/root source, meaningful storage-adapter tests and first actual desktop/mobile UI review. Root serializes captures and does not write to real user storage in native review; fixture storage only for unit tests. Actual browser functional replacement beyond read-only UI remains explicitly unqualified if no isolated native storage owner is admitted.
Acceptance must decide whether these source/unit/actual UI limits suffice for local additive delivery. No whole-avatar appearance or broad roadmap checkbox credit.

effortAndStops.successor: Worth A admits only separate full literal source/primary/test/native ownership planning before implementation. Worth B stops this nomination without code/query.
effortAndStops.implementationTarget: One small page and pure backup-owner module, no migration/backend/sync/thumbnail service. If complete correctness/real UI review cannot be bounded, defer rather than expand.

alternatives.tradeoff: Usable continuity for existing customization and obsolete records, but introduces guarded storage replacement and file lifecycle duties; requires meaningful fidelity/refusal tests and visible review.

alternatives.choice: Keep individual JSON downloads and focus only on character/garment authoring
alternatives.tradeoff: No new storage-write risk or functional scope, but repeated manual backup loses collection names/order and cannot preserve unavailable configurations through the current individual export.

rootReadScope: Full current collection/settings/saved-colour modules read; scoped Showcase renderer/collection/export/HTML source, not full app audit. One combined broader source read truncated; retained only visible complete spans. No native or target evaluation performed.
